scientific_limitations: Applies to fixed positive c and gamma, integer dimension d>=1, and radial indicator cutoffs only.
Asymptotics are for cutoff parameter tending to zero, with fixed spectral threshold.
No quantified remainder rate or nonradial extension is claimed.
Potential earlier equivalent forms in the Bergman-interface literature have not been exhaustively eliminated.
title: Gaussian spectral plunge and sharp projection defect in exponential Bergman balls
